H2CO3: carbonic acid H2CO3, diprotic. So B not both, C not both.
H3PO2: hypophosphorous acid, structure H2PO(OH). It has one P-OH and two P-H, so monoprotic. D: H3BO3 and H3PO2 both monoprotic. So answer D.
